item.title: GitHub Actions: Build a ChatOps System in Three Steps
item.description: In the previous post, Using ChatOps to Improve the R&D Process, providing preview links for Pull Requests through ChatOps improved our agility. This post describes how to implement this feature quickly. 1. Step One: Configure a Trigger 1.1 Choose a Trigger GitHub has three kinds of Workflow triggers: scheduled, manual, and automatic.

item.title: Using ChatOps to Improve the R&D Process
item.description: 1. What Is ChatOps GitOps, ChatOps, AIOps, and the like (hereafter NewOps) are emerging operations philosophies that have appeared in recent years. NewOps separates Ops out of its chaotic state into two parts: one facing users, trending toward being more human, auditable, and traceable; the other facing infrastructure, trending toward being more programmatic, automated, and intelligent.
